claims.claim: Item is an engine oil pump balance shaft assembly
claims.evidence: Witness reports a disassembled gearbox/transmission housing with gear teeth, bearings, dowels and a cast casing marked '5-B' — not an oil pump or balance shaft component, which would be small and shaft-like, not a multi-piece gear housing.
No brand, model, or part-number markings visible in any photo; only an unrelated embossed '5-B' cast mark.
Same as above — no identifying marks link this housing to any specific vehicle or engine.

risks.risk: Fundamental mismatch between seller's part description and the actual photographed item
risks.proof: A single clear photo of the actual oil pump/balance shaft assembly claimed, matching what is being sold
risks.if_unproven: treat as misrepresented listing; price only the item actually shown (gearbox housing section), not the claimed part

risks.risk: Unknown vehicle/engine fitment for the gearbox housing shown
risks.proof: Casting number, VIN tag, or dealer parts lookup photo showing matching part number
risks.if_unproven: price as generic unidentified gearbox housing, worst case

risks.risk: Incompleteness of the gearbox assembly (missing shafts, synchros, clutch housing)
risks.proof: Full-assembly photo or video showing all mating housings and internal shaft set together

risks.risk: Hidden wear or damage to gear teeth, bearings, seals
risks.proof: Close-up video of gear teeth and bearing surfaces under light, rotated 360°
Photo of donor vehicle odometer or teardown documentation

proof_requests: Photo or video of the actual part being sold next to the seller's claimed description (oil pump/balance shaft) to resolve the identity conflict
Casting/part number close-up for fitment verification
Full video of the complete gearbox assembly from multiple angles
Close-up of gear teeth and bearing condition
response.reason: The seller's description (oil pump balance shaft assembly) does not match what the witness independently observed (a disassembled transmission/gearbox housing with gears and bearings), a core mismatch that cannot be resolved remotely and is a classic sign of a mislabeled or scam listing.
